description.content: Real-time solar irradiance, PV power, and weather estimated actuals (last 7 days, updated every 5 minutes).

Get irradiance and weather estimated actuals for near real-time and the past 7 days for the requested location, derived from satellite (clouds and irradiance over non-polar continental areas) and numerical weather models (other data). Data is updated every 5 minutes.

query.description: (Required) Latitude in decimal degrees, between -90 and 90 (north positive).
(Required) Longitude in decimal degrees, between -180 and 180 (east positive).
(Required) Comma-separated list of output parameters to return (e.g., ghi,dni,dhi,air_temp, wind_speed_10m,cloud_opacity,clearsky_ghi).
Time period between data points in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT5M for 5 minutes, PT30M for 30 minutes, PT60M for 60 minutes).
Response format. Defaults to json.

The Solcast API provides live, forecast, historical, and typical meteorological year (TMY) solar irradiance, PV power, and weather data derived from a global fleet of weather satellites. Data covers rooftop PV, advanced PV, grid aggregations, and soiling loss models (Kimber and HSU) globally. Solcast is part of DNV's Green Data Products suite. Authentication uses an API key passed via the Authorization header.
